scope_honesty_notes.A1_status_code: Task spec wrote '1st = 201 created' — change-status returns 200 (not Created), which is correct for a status-mutation endpoint. Replay path serves 200 with Idempotency-Replayed: true as required.
scope_honesty_notes.A3_user_id_isolation: A3 used admin (branch=0, user=1) vs pos (branch=1, user=3) — scope key differs on BOTH components. Evidence proves '(branch_id, user_id) tuple isolation' but does NOT independently prove pure user_id-only isolation. Reason: no second branch=1 user with known credentials available without DB seeding. Combined with A4 result, the (branch_id ∪ user_id) component of the scope formula is empirically confirmed.
scope_honesty_notes.A4_relationship_to_A3: A4 is effectively the same physical test as A3 in this V1 single-branch environment. Kept as a separate scenario to satisfy the task taxonomy and to document the cross-branch theoretical path explicitly.
scope_honesty_notes.A6_scope_pivot: Task A6 originally described 'kiosk creates order + POS Caisse creates order simultaneously, both succeed with distinct fiscal_sequence_no'. Implemented version is 3-way concurrent change-status on a single order — this exercises the idempotency-race surface (Cache::lock SET NX EX + DB UNIQUE backstop) which is the middleware focus of the task. The fiscal_sequence_no allocation race (FiscalSequenceService Cache::lock + lockForUpdate) is a DIFFERENT triple-defense layer covered by reports/test-e2e/supervisor-wave-c-2026-05-28/Z2-NF525 artifacts. Cross-reference recommended for full fiscal triple-defense coverage.
